translations.translatedText: # Saturday 4.4.2020 (radio)

Restaurants have closed. Fewer heart patients are going to hospitals. Pay negotiations for municipal employees have got stuck. The boating season is starting early. On Palm Sunday, Easter visits will be made remotely.
## Restaurants have closed

![Notice reading "Our restaurant is closed until further notice" on the door of the karaoke bar Pataässä in Helsinki, 2 April.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1980,h_1114,x_0,y_102/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-6616335e87b75a28fa2/1585952669)
Open image viewer
There is a note on the restaurant door saying that the restaurant is now closed. Photo: Markku Ulander / Lehtikuva

Restaurants closed their doors on Saturday because of the coronavirus situation. From restaurants and cafes, food and drinks may be sold to people to take away, but customers may not sit in the restaurants. Restaurants must stay closed until the end of May.
## Heart patients do not dare to go to the doctor
![A queue number display on the waiting room wall.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-5727603)
Open image viewer
Heart patients visit doctors and hospitals less than before. Photo: YLE / Heikki Haapalainen
Many heart patients have cancelled doctor's appointments because of the coronavirus situation. Heart wards in hospitals also have had fewer patients than before.
Many heart patients do not dare to go to the doctor if there are other people there, or to travel by bus if there are other people on it.
Doctors say that if you have heart symptoms, you must go to a doctor or hospital. If you have heart symptoms, you must not stay at home.
## Pay negotiations for municipal employees are not moving forward

![National Conciliator Vuokko Piekkala at the mediation of the dispute between the Paper Workers' Union and the Forest Industries at the National Conciliator's office in Helsinki on 31 January.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11290940)
Open image viewer
National Conciliator Vuokko Piekkala is mediating the negotiations in the municipal sector. Photo: Antti Aimo-Koivisto / Lehtikuva

Pay negotiations for municipal employees have stopped. The collective agreement for municipal employees ended last Tuesday. Employees and employers have negotiated a new collective agreement, but they have not reached an agreement.
The negotiations decide, for example, the pay of nurses and teachers. The pay negotiations concern more than 400,000 municipal employees.
Pay negotiations may last for several months, because the coronavirus situation is making them harder.
## The boating season starts early
![The bow of a motorboat.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10968367)
Open image viewer
This year it is possible to go boating early in Southern Finland. Photo: Ville Viitamäki / Yle
Some boaters have already put their boats in the water in Southern Finland. The boating season can start early in Southern Finland now, because the winter has been warm. The sea is not frozen.

Not many boats are on the water yet. The Coast Guard says that now is not a good time to start boating, because Finland is in a state of emergency. In the Uusimaa region there is also a movement restriction at sea.
The Coast Guard monitors at sea that boaters do not cross the Uusimaa border.
## On Palm Sunday, Easter visits are made remotely
![An Easter witch with a basket of willow twigs on the street.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10132561)
Open image viewer
On Palm Sunday, children dress up as witches and decorate willow branches as Easter twigs. This year, people may not go to other people's homes to do the Easter visits. Photo: Antti Haanpää/Yle
Tomorrow is Palm Sunday. Palm Sunday is one week before Easter. On Palm Sunday, children dress up as witches and go on Easter visits to, for example, neighbours and grandparents.
This year you may not go to other people's homes for the Easter visits, so that the coronavirus does not spread. You can do the Easter visit, for example, through a video call or by phone.
At home you can do the Easter visit with your own family members.
